pose_constraints.posture: Clinging vertically to a textured tree trunk; head turned 0-degrees to face the camera.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct frontal view of the chest and head.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The long tail and the unique long feathers on the metatarsus (feet) hang straight down, creating a tall, thin vertical line. Width max 180px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: Focus on the 'four-winged' look where both arm and leg feathers are visible but tucked in to fit the narrow crop.

character_details.expression: Wide-eyed, bird-like curiosity; head tilted slightly to the side.
character_details.texture: Ultra-soft, fluffy 'down' feathers. Color: Iridescent forest-green and cream with soft lavender highlights.

environmental_details.ground: The background is the vertical, mossy bark of a prehistoric tree.
flora: Tiny, detailed moss spores and small fern fronds growing from the bark.
environmental_details.lighting: Dappled sunlight hitting the feathers to create a 'magical forest' glow.
environmental_details.sky: Soft-focus misty forest canopy in the far distance.
